newsitem.title: USA: U.S. spot jet soars on NYMEX rally, diffs mixed.
newsitem.headline: U.S. spot jet soars on NYMEX rally, diffs mixed.

text.p: U.S. spot jet fuel prices jumped higher as NYMEX prices shot up, while cash differentials ended mixed.
Traders attributed the NYMEX rally to the ongoing French refinery strike as well as the blast at Star's Convent, Louisiana refinery Wednesday evening.
New York Harbor prompt 54-grade jet fuel trimmed its lead on the spot NYMEX contract to 2.75 cents, down about 0.50 cent from Wednesday.
However, USG diffs firmed slightly, with prompt 54-grade barrels offered at 0.75 cent under the screen.
-- Matt Daily, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1626
